modules_tested: contracts::ownership (17 tests) — DTO validation, miror/promotion/canonical semantics
contracts::delivery (37 tests) — delivery package, delivery status enum, mapping
contracts::evidence_rollup (13 tests) — summary-sized contract, indirect artifact refs
residual_integration_assumptions: PostgreSQL database with matching schema is required for TaskRepository and task integration tests (14 tests in state::repository and contracts::task)
Main binary (src/main.rs) ingest handlers are tested purely at the logic layer — database wiring (AppState, sqlx::PgPool) is not exercised in unit tests
DependencyResolver, LeaseReaper, and BackoffAwakener background loops are not covered by focused tests — they require a live database connection and async runtime integration

DeliveryStatus TryFrom mapping assumes the cross-domain vocabulary is exactly: proposed, accepted, needs_revision, rejected, superseded — any additions to the shared vocabulary require updating both the enum and tests::test_mapping_unsupported_values
ReviewSurface validation assumes submitted_at precedes reviewed_at — no cross-field temporal validation beyond existence is implemented
Ownership validate() rejects miror + promoted_from as an invalid transition — this assumes miror ownership never carries lineage, which is consistent with the task_graph domain model
